title: Hongik Harness: Emergency Reflex Layer & Storm Doctor (wkdr)
desc: Autonomous self-healing protocol for AI automation environments under resource storm or process cascade.
steps: 1. SYMPTOM RECOGNITION: identify system lag, CPU/RAM storms, or wkappbot-core spawn cascades (100+ procs).
2. ACT FIRST (! Reflex): Trigger '! wkdr' (standard self-heal) or '! wkdr nuke' (force-kill all non-essential procs). Use leading '!' to indicate priority/reflex.
3. DIAGNOSTIC RESTRAINT: Do NOT run 'Get-CimInstance' or 'Get-Process' during WMI storms; use cached 'wktasklist' or native 'tasklist' to avoid fuel-injection.
4. ROOT CAUSE HEAL: For respawn loops, clear the Windows Run-key for 'WKAppBot Eye Startup Recovery'.
